shared.Eucla: Australian locality without a Galician exonym, so the proper name stays unchanged.
shared.Interface: International technical term whose Galician spelling is identical to the English one.
shared.Islamabad, Karachi: Pakistani city names without established Galician exonyms; both stay unchanged.
shared.Kathmandu: Nepalese capital without an established Galician exonym, so the proper name stays unchanged.
shared.Variable: Galician noun that is spelled exactly like the English label it translates.
shared.d: Abbreviation for days used after a number; it is identical in Galician.

notes: Values that legitimately match the English source: international unit symbols, proper nouns without Galician exonyms, and one same-spelling Galician noun.
